REAL ISSUE: createAndStoreSeed() has no mutex/in-flight guard. Two concurrent calls generate two different seeds; both write to the same alias and each caller believes its returned seed is the stored one. In a wallet this can orphan funds. wipeAllKeychainData racing createAndStoreSeed is also unguarded.
